/bin/bash -lc "python - <<'PY'
import json, re
path='/mnt/data/LSF/data/financebench/processing/AMAZON_2022_10K_reconstructed.json'
with open(path) as f:
    data=json.load(f)
texts=data.get('texts', [])
patterns=[re.compile(r'total net sales', re.I), re.compile(r'total revenue', re.I), re.compile(r'net sales', re.I), re.compile(r'consolidated statements of operations', re.I), re.compile(r'audited', re.I)]
for i,el in enumerate(texts):
    txt=el.get('text','')
    if any(p.search(txt) for p in patterns):
        print('IDX',i,'PAGE',el.get('page_no'),'LABEL',el.get('label'),'STRUCT',el.get('structure'))
        print(txt[:1000].replace('\\n',' '))
        print('---')
PY"
